reason: The change is opt-in (UseLocalTime defaults to false, preserving existing UTC cron behavior) but converts TimerEvent's core CanExecute/Resume methods to async and adds new DI dependencies (ISiteService, ILogger), so any custom code overriding or directly instantiating TimerEvent outside the standard workflow engine could break.
